rows.en: You're mine nowww!!
I don't wanna do this either... But still!!
Guess it's gotta be me... It's gotta be ME!
I ain't leavin' it all to Ikari and Soryu!
I'll show ya what EVA-03 can do!
When it's time to step up, I step up too!!
Don't you dare look down on me!!
Hold still, you!
I gotta do it... I just gotta!!
I'll show ya what guts look like!!
N-no way... Is this as far as I go...!?
Uwaaah!! I ain't dyin' in a place like this!!
D-don't you mess with a guy from Kansai!!
N-no way I'm the only one goin' down out here!!
Uwaaah!! Wh-what the hell is this thing!?
Guh! Th-this is turnin' into a real mess!!
Whoa! S-so I can't pull it off like Ikari does!?
I-I'm an EVA pilot too! I'll show ya my guts!!
Cr-crap! If this keeps up...!!
Ngh! I ain't lookin' any more lame than this!
Huh? What, did somebody just touch me!?
Heh! Like that's gonna work on me!
What's wrong? Is that all ya got!?
Shoot! I got hit!!
Even I can dodge somethin' like that!
Where d'ya think you're aimin'!?
Man, you're hopeless~
Whoa there! That one was close~
Like I'd get hit by somethin' like that!
Hey, hey, what're ya doin'!
Wha~t's that? What a boring attack.
The AT Field is invincible!
AT Field, full power!
What!? I'm outta ammo!?
Shoot! I can't reach!!
D-dammit! Y-you ain't heard the last of me!!
Not yet! It ain't over yet!!
I'm gonna settle this proper!!
Get outta my way!!
Alright, here I go!!
Here goes, then...!
I'm gonna hit ya, no matter what!!
Watch this, I'll give ya a headbutt!!
Uwaaaaaah!!
Raaaaaaaah!!
rows.notes: Shared with Asuka; neutral battle cry.

rows.en: C'mon, please, just hit!
There!!
Outta my way!!
I can do this!
Don't you underestimate me!
Fine, I'll show you how it's done!
I'll show you what EVA-02 can do!
Asuka, here I go...!
No way... You're kidding!? EVA-03 is the enemy...!
That dopey face of yours pisses me off!
I'm gonna smash that smirking face to bits!
Why yooouuu!
You've got some nerve!
You're finished here too!
That's it, I'm mad! Now you're gonna get it!
Laying a hand on me... Are you stupid or something!?
N-no way!?
I don't want this... Is this the end for me?
You're kidding! Me!? I can't believe it!
Argh! This isn't good enough, this isn't good enough!
Nngh! Not yet, I'm not done yet!!
No way am I going down!!
Agh! I can still... I can still fight!
Ngh! Th-this might be bad...
Kuaah! Wh-why won't you listen to me!?
I won't accept it...! I refuse to accept it!
Me... being put through this!?
I'll never forgive you...! Humiliating me like this!
Nngh! I'll smash you to pieces...!
Those annoying arms of yours... I'll rip them off!
Don't laugh! Don't you... laugh at meee!
Dammit... All you've got going for you is numbers!
rows.notes: Likely vs. the Mass Production EVAs.

rows.en: Aaaaaaaaaah!!
!! Uwaaaah!!
Ow! Now you've done it!!
L-like I'd go down from something like this!!
I'm hit!? But I'm not done yet!
Nngh! Why yooouuu!
Owww... How dare you, how dare you!
Why you! I'll pay you back ten times over for this!
I'm just getting started!
Ugh!? You've got some nerve pulling that...!
It didn't hurt! It didn't hurt at all!
Tch, how could I, of all people...!
I'm neutralizing its AT Field, so why isn't it hurt!?
rows.notes: Japanese says the field should be neutralized; I made Asuka the subject (she neutralizes the enemy's field).

rows.en: What are you, an idiot!
Hah! Like that'd work on me!!
Ngh! How dare you scratch my EVA!
Pfft, what kind of attack is that!
You think an attack like that would work on me!?
I'm hit!?
uncertain: Read as being hit (sits among damage lines); could also be 'Did it hit!?' on attack. Works for Masato either way only if the context is the same.

rows.en: That doesn't even count as a scratch!
Are you making fun of me!?
As long as I don't take a direct hit!
No way...! It got taken over by an Angel!
uncertain: Subject unstated; read as EVA-03 being hijacked (Bardiel). 'It' kept vague.

rows.en: I'm hit!? Quit smirking at me!
uncertain: Read as Asuka getting hit by a grinning enemy; could be 'Did it hit!?' on attack.

rows.en: Hmph, so the only problem is your numbers, huh.
Hmph, you came right where I thought you would.
Like that'll hit me!
Hmph, where do you think you're aiming!
Too easy, too easy! As if that would ever hit me!!
Are you an idiot or what!?
Geez, what a boring attack.
Do I really have to deal with this?
Are you stupid?
Hmph! What are you doing!
What do you think you're doing!
Haa~ah, what a bore!
You're a hundred million years too early to take me on!
With skills like that, you'd better aim at someone else!
There's no way I'm letting that hit me!
Stupid, like that'd ever work on me!!
AT Field, deploy!
As if an attack like that could work on me!
Why you! Field, full power!
Wie!? I'm out of ammo!?
rows.notes: WIE is German 'What'; kept as Asuka's German.

rows.en: Wh-what the heck, I can't reach it!
Ugh, how uncool...
Clear the way for me!
Move, move! Out of my way!
The great Asuka will show you how it's done
Stupid Shinji! You owe me for this one!
I have to follow THIS one? That pisses me off!
uncertain: Support-attack line; read as Asuka attacking after an ally. Ally's gender unknown, kept 'this one'.

rows.en: And you're nothing but dead weight!
This is why I said I could handle it alone!
I'll block it for you!
You could at least be a little grateful!
You're too slow, I can't stand watching! Stupid Shinji!
Geez, what are you doing! First Child!
rows.notes: Faasuto = Rei; rendered First Child per glossary term.

rows.en: Rookies should just stay out of the way!
I'm the leader, any objections? Let's go!
Fine, let's go all the way with this!
I know! Leave it to me!
EVA-02, backing you up!
I'll finish this right away!
Raaaaaah!
I'll deal with you personally!
Don't think you'll get off easy!
Neeext!
And this... is the end!
Out of my way!!
Hit, damn you!
You'd better be ready!
Don't you get in my way!
Stay right there and don't move!
Don't think you can escape my aim!
I can see right through your moves!!
I'm gonna hit you, no matter what!
Prepare yourself!
Don't you move from that spot!
I'll finish it with this!
Take that, that, that, thaaat~!
Tch! Next!
Go down, go down! Go dooown already!
Here's a bonus!
Damn yooouuu!
Take... thiiis!
Here's how you use an AT Field! Like this!
Hraaaaaaaah!
Disappeeeeear!!
Damn yooouuuuu!!
Doryaaaaaah!!
I can't afford to looose! Not to you peopleeee!!
Haaaaaaah!!
Ugh! You're so persisteeent!!
Disappeeear!!
Noooooooo!!
...I'll kill you, I'll kill you, I'll kill you, I'll kill you...!!
! Ugh!?
Ngh, not bad! Now things are getting interesting!
Don't underestimate the EVA's special armor!
Like I'd get hit by an attack like that!!
You're ten billion years too early to hit me!
Now I get it! What the AT Field means! It's protecting me!
U-ugh!!
And this is the laaaaast!!
Graaaaaaah...!!
Having to fight may be a sad thing...
Do you understand? The meaning of this battle?
I won't hold back.
One or the other... is it?
It's the Plank of Carneades...
That I go on living... that, too, is fate.
Now, let us begin.
Humans can never be rid of loneliness. Yes, just like you are now...
This, too, was fate.
What lies ahead... can you see it?
Can you accept the possibility that I represent?
Shinji... This was always meant to happen...
Don't be sad, Shinji.
Life and death are of equal value... When you understand that, you...
Hello... We meet again, Shinji.
Shinji, this is a rite of passage. So that you can claim your future.
The EVA Series... The hope of the Lilin, is it...
The tuning of the world... That, too, is one possibility...
Your song cannot reach me.
uncertain: Opponent singing is unclear (song-based enemy); kept literal.

rows.en: Go on, sing. Your forbidden song...
Now... soothe my heart with your song.
Who will reach the far shore of time... Me, or all of you...
rows.notes: open/close split kept: this half ends without closing bracket.

rows.en: No... perhaps this place is already that shore.
It can't be helped.
I understand your heart.
As for how this ends... No, let's not.
Yes... That's right...
You need a future. Thank you. I was glad I got to meet you.
My own death... That is my one absolute freedom...
...Life and death are of equal value... Hence... this ending...
A good attack. Keep it up.
You're strong... all of you...
Life and death are of equal value. To me, at least.
Lilin who go this far to survive... I don't understand them.
...Is this the ending...?
That is power beyond your station...
That power... will change everything, won't it?
I don't mind... This is a rite of passage, so that you can claim your future.
That's right, Shinji... You need a future.
Now, erase me. If you don't, you will be the ones erased.
If you don't fight for real... you'll lose.
Lilin, you are strong. But at the same time... fragile...
Yes, you are not beings who are meant to die.
So this is the answer you've reached...
Just as I thought...
It seems my question... was asked in vain.
The answer hasn't been decided yet.
If that is the answer you've reached... I don't mind.
No, that won't do.
Your power is more than that, isn't it?
You mean to defeat me, don't you? Then you have to get serious.
This place can never be your paradise...
With a heart full of doubt... you can't do it.
This is reality... You mustn't look away.
No, Shinji... You mustn't close off your heart.
There's no need to hesitate...
You missed. You need to aim more carefully.
What's wrong? You're not hitting me.
Is that all you have?
Don't you understand... why it came to this?
If you keep your heart closed, this is what happens...
This will become the wall that divides you and me...
That attack won't work on me.
A sacred realm no one may violate... The light of the heart.
AT Field... That's what you call it, isn't it?
A wall of the heart... It's something everyone has.
Things without souls... naturally have their limits.
What's wrong...?
Because that is what wisdom is.
I see... It can't reach.
You let your heart go slack, didn't you?
I'm right here.
Now, allow me to begin.
I understand.
That's the target...? Isn't that an EVA!?
That thing... is an Angel!?
Hmph...!
You're mine!!
You mean to face me head-on? Laughable!!
This farce is over! Here I come!
How tiresome for you! Fighting with something to protect...!
Still struggling in vain at this late stage!
Here I come, Dendoh!!
Dendoh! This is the end for you!!
Scurrying about like vermin! You're an eyesore!
Don't get cocky!!
Enough playing around!
I won't allow you to interfere any further!!
Damn! Is this as far as I go...
I'll let you keep your life... for now!
...Haa, haa... You bastard...!!
I won't forgive you... I won't forgive you...!
Grr, Knight Ogre, pushed this far...!!
rows.notes: Kishi Ouga = Knight GEAR Ogre; short form Knight Ogre as used elsewhere in the corpus.

rows.en: To think you could gouge a GEAR's armor...
I cannot disgrace myself before His Majesty any further...!
Nnngh...!? You... who are you...!?
Nnngh...!! I won't forgive you, Dendoh!!
Tch! I let my guard down!
Hmph, you did well... for the likes of you.
Grr, what a disgrace...!
Cheap tricks...!!
Uaah...!? What on earth is happening to me!?
uncertain: Subject restored as Altair himself (likely a memory-manipulation reaction); Japanese leaves it open.

rows.en: So you can do a little, Dendoh...!
Oh... So you managed to touch me.
Heh, I'll commend you for that spirit...!
Why not admit your own powerlessness for once?
You think you can win with that!?
What... was that feeling just now...!?
Hmph...! Foolish pilot!
You're no match for me!
A worthless trick...!
Too slow!
rows.notes: Shared with Gun Jem, Hugo Medio and others.

rows.en: Amateur!
rows.notes: Shared with Werner Fritz, Maillot Prado.

rows.en: Heh, with a pilot of that caliber...
Hmph, it's useless!
You should only make a move if you can win... Am I wrong?
Heh... How pathetic.
You'll never catch up to me!
Illusion, Flash!
rows.notes: Glossary term Illusion Flash; the comma mirrors the Japanese pause.

rows.en: Damn! After I had them cornered like this!!
Those wretches, what trick did they pull!?
Hm...! From that position...
Hmph, you've escaped with your life...!
Finishing bloooow!
This is no opponent you can handle...!
All units, form an encirclement!
It was a fun game, but it seems I'll be the one laughing last...!
Time for me to settle this!
Hmph! It can't be helped...!
Teyaaaaaah!!
Wave, Dragon God Strike!
rows.notes: Glossary weapon Wave Dragon God Strike; comma mirrors the Japanese pause.

rows.en: Flash Thunder Blade Strike!
Would you mind keeping this one busy for a while?
uncertain: Addressee unclear (possibly a summoned data weapon or ally); kept polite and neutral.

rows.en: File Load, Viper Whip!
uncertain: 'File Load' (fairu roodo) not in glossary; rendered literally.

rows.en: Go! Beat that one to a pulp!!
Show me you can dispose of small fry like that
uncertain: Addressee unclear (likely a data weapon Altair sends in); no punctuation in source, kept none.

rows.en: Viper Whip, Final Attack!!
File Load, Bull Horn!
Auto Pressure!
Bull Horn, Final Attack!!
There's no way a bright future awaits the likes of you!
Foolish humans, daring to defy the Gulfer!!
It is you humans who bring endless chaos to the universe!
Foolish humans!!
Vega...!
Vega... Why has it come to this...!
It's because of you... because the likes of you exist!!
Knight Ogre, into battle!!
Let's go, Ogre!!
I'll end this now!!
Even I get another chance...! Here I go!!
uncertain: Fragment in source ('even to me, again...'); read as Altair being given a second chance to fight on the right side.

rows.en: I'll simply carry out the mission I've been given!!
Then I'll show you the power of our feelings!!
I'm your opponent!! Zero!!
It's over, Zero!!
The heartless can never create a future!!
Now it's my turn...! Ogre!
I trust you're prepared...!
Now you're the one struggling in vain!
Know that clouding our future is a crime!!
You will vanish here!! You!!
I'll atone for my mistakes with my own life!!
uncertain: Source trails off ('those mistakes, with this body!!'); verb atone restored. Could also mean stopping someone else's mistake with his body.

rows.en: Careless of me... Is this the end...!
Guh! Hold on, Ogre...!!
I can't give up here... I won't!!
Not until I fulfill my mission...!
Even if it costs me my life... I will defeat you!!
You can't win a battle on spirit alone!!
I can't fall here!!
Hmph! Not yet!!
I can't afford to lose! Zero!!
To think you could defeat Ogre with that... How laughable!!
That's not nearly enough!!
With resolve like that, you won't defeat me!
Is that all, Zero!!
As if I couldn't dodge that!!
Haah!!
I've seen through it!
Ogre!!
Useless!!
I can't afford to keep getting hit!
This is the power I've been granted!
Hyaaah!!
Nn... Ogre's energy is...!
Ngh, it's slipped into my blind spot...!
Careless of me...
Follow me, Ogre!!
It's too early to relax!
I won't let this chance slip by...!
Vega! Leave the rest to me!
Subaru... Well done.
We're going in too! Dendoh!!
I won't let you!!
Get back on your feet!
uncertain: Support line; read as Altair telling an ally to regroup.

rows.en: I'll be your shield!!
Look out! Vega!!
No! Subaru!
Fall back for now! Hokuto, Ginga!!
This is the last one...! I'm going in!!
uncertain: kakaru read as 'I'm attacking'; could be an order to attack.

rows.en: Let's strike all at once!
Heh, leave it to me!
I'll go along with that plan...!
Teyaaaaaaah!!
Haaaaaaaah!!
Deyaaah!!
Wave, Dragon God Strike!!
Flash, Thunder, Blade, Strike!
Viper Whip!
Final, Attaaaaack!!
A sword in which people's hope and future dwell...
Take it, and take it well!!
Here I goooo!!
Altair, let's go!
rows.notes: Combo line spoken by Ginga or Hokuto (shared with Ginga); -san honorific dropped as elsewhere in the corpus.
uncertain: Speaker inferred: Dendoh pilot to Altair, not Altair.

rows.en: Don't fall behind!
Heh... Leave it to me!
Gale! Triple! Strike!!
Gale Double Strike!!
